headline: Coast guard says it drove away 16 Chinese vessels in coordinated 'maritime harassment' operation around Taiwan + Pratas
dek: Taiwan's coast guard said it drove away 16 Chinese coast guard, research and fishing vessels (incl. 4 fishing boats) in simultaneous coordinated operations around Taiwan's main island (eastern, southern, southwestern coasts) and Pratas (Dongsha); some entered Taiwan's restricted waters; CGA called…
sources: Taiwan Coast Guard Administration statement via AFP (Malay Mail); Taipei Times; Taiwan MoNDefense; Tribune India
fault_line: Grey-zone pressure campaign — or the rehearsal for a Pratas blockade?

sections.what_happened: Taiwan's coast guard said it drove away 16 Chinese coast guard, research and fishing vessels (incl. 4 fishing boats) in simultaneous coordinated operations around Taiwan's main island (eastern, southern, southwestern coasts) and Pratas (Dongsha); some entered Taiwan's restricted waters; CGA called it 'hybrid warfare' and took 'forceful action'. 'Unusually large' number of vessels. Comes after Oct 1 Taiwan water-cannon incident vs Chinese fishing vessel near Pratas; CGA: 244 Chinese vessels detected last month vs 55 in June and 30 in May; Taipei Times: 2 CCG vessels (3301, 3303) entered Pratas restricted waters Friday; MND: 9 PLA sorties, 6 PLAN vessels, 8 official ships in 24h to Sat morning, 5 sorties crossing median line.
sections.what_verified: AFP wire pick-up; Taipei Times confirms Friday Pratas incursions (vessel numbers 3301/3303); Taiwan MND daily counts corroborate elevated PLA activity; CGA monthly stats via Taipei Times.
sections.what_disputed: No PRC-side response published yet in this window. Beijing's standing position: waters around Taiwan are under Chinese jurisdiction; such operations are routinely framed as law-enforcement patrols. Taipei's 'hybrid warfare' framing is Taiwan's characterization, not neutral fact.
sections.why_matters: From Beijing's side per the stance lock: Chinese coast guard 'law-enforcement patrols' in waters Beijing claims; Taipei calls it hybrid warfare and sent ships to drive them off. Label everything: the 16-vessel figure and 'forceful action' are the Taiwan CGA's claims; the jurisdiction dispute is the core. Context numbers: 244 vessels last month vs 55 in June; Oct 1 water-cannon incident.
sections.context: Background: Taiwan — NEW: coast guard says it drove away 16 Chinese vessels in coordinated 'maritime harassment' operation around Taiwan + Pratas
